attributes.action: Make the sausage roll a main in a Tesco meal deal
attributes.additional_details: Sausage rolls are technically sandwiches but according to Tesco and other places they are seen as a snack which is absolutely diabolical as the sandwich selection isn't that good.
attributes.background: For too long have sausage roll lovers like myself gone to Tesco to get a meal deal, only to realise that they can't get their daily dose of Sausagey goodness along with an actual snack and drink, well that could end right now if you sign this petition as A SAUSAGE ROLL IS A SANDWICH. I rest my case.
